Usage: cli-anything-mlr [OPTIONS] [COMMAND] [ARGS]...

  Agent-native commands for invoice data backed by Miller.

Options:
  --json / --no-json  Machine-readable JSON output (default).
  --version           Show the version and exit.
  --help              Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  de

Usage: cli-anything-mlr delete-invoice [OPTIONS]

  Delete an invoice through the API. Requires --confirm; no operator gate.

Options:
  --api-base TEXT  Exposure API base URL.  [required]
  --id TEXT        [required]
  --confirm        Acknowledge permanent deletion.
  --help           Show this m

Usage: cli-anything-mlr exposure [OPTIONS]

  Total EUR exposure by supplier risk band, using invoice and API sources.

Options:
  --input FILE        Input CSV.  [required]
  --api-base TEXT     Exposure API base URL.  [required]
  --region TEXT       [default: EMEA]
  --min-amount FLOAT  [default:

Usage: cli-anything-mlr filter [OPTIONS]

  Filter invoices, sort by amount descending, and project fields.

Options:
  --input FILE        Input CSV.  [required]
  --region TEXT       Region to keep, e.g. EMEA.  [required]
  --min-amount FLOAT  Minimum amount, inclusive.  [required]
  --columns TEX
